purpose: Diagnostic calibration of graph-free MUSA Event batch-time slopes. MUSAGraph and torch Profiler are excluded because P7.1 established their runtime path as unreliable on this host.
rules: Each trial is a fresh process; compile, one launch, correctness, warmup, then timing in this order.
No MUSAGraph and no torch Profiler may be created by this protocol.
Each batch is followed by torch.musa.synchronize().
The fitted intercept and slope are reported rather than subtracting a separately measured empty-event value.
A case is accepted only if all three trials pass correctness and measurement gates; otherwise it remains pending_short_kernel_method.
No P5/P6/P9 model or hold-out artifact may be modified.
